item.title: Bill increasing school funding 1.75% passes Iowa Senate
item.description: DES MOINES, Iowa -- A bill increasing school funding by 1.75% passed the Iowa Senate on Tuesday. The Senate's proposal, SF 2201, increases funding 1.75% for the 2026-27 school year, a decrease from recent years.
